basic_details.job_title: IIT Guwahati Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 21 Administrative Assistant, SRF and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Centre for Nanotechnology, Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati, has invited applications for 21 posts in 11 designations in the project "Indian Nanoelectronics Users' Programme - Idea to Innovation (INUP-i2i2)". Each post has a duration of appointment of 06 months, with a total amount from 11975.00 to 87626.00 including HRA and medical. Candidates apply online at the Recruitment Portal of the Research & Development Cell, IIT Guwahati, by 3 December 2026, 5:30 PM. The offline interview is on 7 December 2026 at 10:00 AM at the Centre for Nanotechnology, IIT Guwahati.

qualification.details: The notice says the SRF qualification is "selected through a process described through any one of the following": | Scholars selected through National Eligibility Test - CSIR-UGC NET including Lectureship (Assistant Professorship) and GATE. The selection process through National Level Examinations conducted by Central Government Departments and their Agencies and institutions such as DST, DBT, DAE, DOs, DRDO, MHRD, ICAR, ICMR, IISc, IISCR etc., +2yrs of Research Exp.

how_to_apply: Go to the Recruitment Portal of the Research & Development Cell, IIT Guwahati (https://iitg.ac.in/rndproj/recruitment/).
Follow the instructions and guidelines provided on the portal.
Find the relevant position by searching for the project title "Indian Nanoelectronics Users' Programme - Idea to Innovation (INUP-i2i2)".
Submit the application online by 3 December 2026, 5:30 PM.

For technical assistance with the online application, the notice gives the email [email protected]. For any other clarification, contact O/o Centre for Nanotechnology, IIT Guwahati, email [email protected], phone 03612583075. The notice does not list documents to attach.
important_instructions: No campus accommodation will be available for the selected candidates. No TA/DA will be paid to the candidates for appearing in the test and interview. Only shortlisted candidates will be intimated via email for the interview.

content_sections.heading: IIT Guwahati Recruitment 2026 at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit or the application fee.

rows.details: Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati, Research and Development Section
Indian Nanoelectronics Users' Programme - Idea to Innovation (INUP-i2i2)
SRF (Direct), Sr. Project Engineer, Project Engineer, Project Scientist, Associate Project Engineer and other posts
Pay recommended 9089.00 to 73200.00, plus HRA and medical 1250.00; total amount 11975.00 to 87626.00, by post

content_sections.heading: About IIT Guwahati
content_sections.text: Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati is located at Guwahati-781039, Assam. This notice comes from its Research and Development Section and is for posts in the INUP-i2i2 project at the Centre for Nanotechnology. The notice is signed by the Assistant Registrar (R&D).

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 21 vacancies in 11 designations. Category-wise break-up is not given.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Qualification and experience are printed post by post. The notice prints no age limit and no desirable qualification. The notice says the SRF qualification is "selected through a process described through any one of the following": Scholars selected through National Eligibility Test - CSIR-UGC NET including Lectureship (Assistant Professorship) and GATE. The selection process through National Level Examinations conducted by Central Government Departments and their Agencies and institutions such as DST, DBT, DAE, DOs, DRDO, MHRD, ICAR, ICMR, IISc, IISCR etc., +2yrs of Research Exp.

rows.qualification_and_experience_required: Post Graduate in basic science or Graduate/Post Graduate in Professional Course selected through a process described below, +2yrs of Research Exp.
PhD degree + 3yrs exp. OR Master's degree in Engineering + 6yrs.Exp.
PhD degree Or Master's degree in Engineering + 3 yrs exp. Or Bachelor's degree in Engineering + 6 yrs exp.
PhD degree Or Master's degree in Science + 6 yrs exp.
Master's degree in Engineering Or Bachelor's degree in Engineering +3 yrs exp.
PhD degree + 3 yrs exp. OR Master's degree in Science +6 yrs. exp.
Master's degree in Science or Bachelor's degree in Science +4 yrs exp.
Master's degree in Commerce +3 yrs exp.
MCA or MS in Computer Science/ Data Science + 5 yrs exp

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The notice prints pay recommended, HRA required and medical required for each post, with the total amount. The duration of appointment is 06 months for every post.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Guwahati Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Go to the Recruitment Portal of the Research & Development Cell, IIT Guwahati ( https://iitg.ac.in/rndproj/recruitment/ ). Follow the instructions and guidelines provided on the portal. Find the relevant position by searching for the project title "Indian Nanoelectronics Users' Programme - Idea to Innovation (INUP-i2i2)". Submit the application online by 3 December 2026, 5:30 PM. For technical assistance with the online application, the notice gives the email [email protected] . For any other clarification, contact O/o Centre for Nanotechnology, IIT Guwahati, email [email protected] , phone 03612583075. The notice does not list documents to attach.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice invites applications for an offline interview. Only shortlisted candidates will be intimated via email for the interview. The notice does not describe the shortlisting method. Date of Interview: 7 December 2026 Time: 10:00 AM Venue: Centre for Nanotechnology, IIT Guwahati

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No campus accommodation will be available for the selected candidates. No TA/DA will be paid to the candidates for appearing in the test and interview. Only shortlisted candidates will be intimated via email for the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IIT Guwahati Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 21 vacancies in 11 designations: SRF (Direct) 08, Associate Project Engineer 02, Associate Project Scientist 02, Administrative Assistant 02, and 01 each in the other seven posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date of application is 3 December 2026, 5:30 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for SRF (Direct)?
faq.answer: Post Graduate in basic science or Graduate/Post Graduate in Professional Course selected through NET (CSIR-UGC NET including Lectureship, and GATE) or national level examinations, +2yrs of Research Exp.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Laboratory Attendant?
faq.answer: School Education (Class 5 or above) is the qualification printed for Laboratory Attendant.

faq.question: Q5. What is the pay for these posts?
faq.answer: Pay recommended ranges from 9089.00 (Laboratory Attendant) to 73200.00 (Sr. Project Engineer and Sr. Project Scientist). HRA and medical 1250.00 are added in the total amount, which runs from 11975.00 to 87626.00.

faq.question: Q6. How to apply for IIT Guwahati project posts?
faq.answer: Apply online at the Recruitment Portal of the Research & Development Cell, IIT Guwahati, and search for the project title INUP-i2i2 to reach the relevant position.

faq.question: Q7. When and where is the interview?
faq.answer: The offline interview is on 7 December 2026 at 10:00 AM at the Centre for Nanotechnology, IIT Guwahati. Only shortlisted candidates will be intimated via email.

faq.question: Q8. How long is the appointment?
faq.answer: The duration of appointment is 06 months for every post in the notice.

faq.question: Q9. Will TA/DA or accommodation be provided?
faq.answer: No. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the test and interview, and no campus accommodation will be available for the selected candidates.

faq.question: Q10. Who should be contacted for help?
faq.answer: For technical help with the online application, email [email protected]. For other clarification, email [email protected] or call 03612583075 (O/o Centre for Nanotechnology, IIT Guwahati).
